changes: Align Arabic prose in Source, Split and Visual using continuous text layout and bundled Amiri for the monospaced Source defaults. Preserve literal whitespace during native editing.

Use native pixel comparisons, semantic Markdown parsing and saved-byte checks for editing regressions.
Update the Rust URL dependency to 2.5.9 to address RUSTSEC-2026-0592.
